title: Actors
subtitle: 演員、表演者、劇中演出人員——哪些詞真的接近 actors？
description: 演員、表演者、劇中演出人員——哪些詞真的接近 actors？

words.note: 最廣泛而自然的近義詞之一。可以指演員，也可以包括歌手、舞者、喜劇演員等，因此範圍比 actors 稍廣。

exercises.original: The actors received loud applause at the end of the show.
exercises.upgrade: The actors received loud applause at the end of the show.

exercises.original: The actors had to rehearse the dance sequence several times.
exercises.upgrade: The actors had to rehearse the dance sequence several times.

options.explanation: 演員作為表演者很自然。

words.note: 較傳統的說法，可指戲劇演員，尤其常見於劇團、舞台表演或較文學化語境。

exercises.original: The actors returned to the stage for another bow.
exercises.upgrade: The actors returned to the stage for another bow.

exercises.original: The theatre company employed twelve actors for the production.
exercises.upgrade: The theatre company employed twelve actors for the production.

words.meaning: 演員陣容中的成員；劇組演員
words.note: 表示某一齣電影、電視劇、舞台劇或節目的演員之一。和 actors 很接近，但特別強調屬於某個 cast。

exercises.original: Several actors attended the television drama's launch event.
exercises.upgrade: Several actors attended the television drama's launch event.

options.explanation: 指這一部劇的演員成員。
可用但沒有「屬於該劇 cast」的精確度。

exercises.original: The actors spent six months filming the final season.
exercises.upgrade: The actors spent six months filming the final season.

words.note: 和 cast members 幾乎完全相同，只是形式更完整、更自然於正式敘述。

exercises.original: All the actors attended the final rehearsal.
exercises.upgrade: All the actors attended the final rehearsal.

exercises.original: Three actors were absent because of illness.
exercises.upgrade: Three actors were absent because of illness.

words.note: 較文學化、幽默或帶傳統戲劇色彩的詞。通常指舞台或戲劇演員，不如 actors 普通日常。

exercises.original: The festival celebrates actors from independent theatre companies.
exercises.upgrade: The festival celebrates actors from independent theatre companies.

exercises.original: Several veteran actors shared stories about their early years on stage.
exercises.upgrade: Several veteran actors shared stories about their early years on stage.

words.note: 當 actors 明確指劇院、話劇、音樂劇等現場舞台演出者時，可以使用。
words.example: 這裡的 actors 是否明確是在舞台上現場演出？

exercises.original: The actors had to project their voices to the back of the theatre.
exercises.upgrade: The actors had to project their voices to the back of the theatre.

exercises.original: Unlike film actors, these actors perform in front of a live audience every night.
exercises.upgrade: Unlike film actors, these actors perform in front of a live audience every night.

words.note: 表示在電影、電視或其他螢幕媒體中演出的演員。比 actors 更強調媒介。

exercises.original: Film actors often repeat the same scene from several camera angles.
exercises.upgrade: Film actors often repeat the same scene from several camera angles.

exercises.original: Television actors may work on several episodes in the same week.
exercises.upgrade: Television actors may work on several episodes in the same week.

options.explanation: 電視演員屬影視表演者。

words.note: 較正式，指進行戲劇表演的人。語義很接近 actors，但日常使用頻率較低。

exercises.original: The school trains actors in voice, movement, and character development.
exercises.upgrade: The school trains actors in voice, movement, and character development.

exercises.original: Professional actors must often adapt their technique to different performance spaces.
exercises.upgrade: Professional actors must often adapt their technique to different performance spaces.

falseSynonyms.zh: 角色不等於演員 Character 是故事中的人物；actor 是扮演該人物的人。
falseSynonyms.point: The character is a detective. The actor playing him is from Ireland.

falseSynonyms.zh: 明星不等於所有演員 Star 指特別知名、重要或主角級的演員；很多 actors 並不是 stars。
falseSynonyms.point: The film features several young actors. Its biggest star appears only briefly.

falseSynonyms.zh: 藝人不等於演員 Entertainer 範圍更廣，可以是歌手、主持人、魔術師、喜劇演員等。
falseSynonyms.point: Actors are one type of performer. An entertainer does not necessarily act in dramatic roles.

falseSynonyms.zh: 藝術工作者不等於演員 Artist 可以指畫家、音樂家、舞者、創作者等，範圍遠比 actor 廣。
名人不等於演員 Celebrity 的核心是知名度，而不是職業。名人可以是運動員、歌手、網紅或演員。
幕後工作人員不等於演員 Crew 通常指導演、攝影、燈光、化妝、音響等幕後工作人員；cast 才是演員陣容。
臨時演員／群眾演員不是所有 actors 的一般同義詞 Extras 是沒有主要對白或角色的重要背景演員，只是 actor 的一個子類。
主演不等於所有演員 Lead 指主要角色的演員；只是整個 cast 中的一部分。
